name: seo-ops
description: SEO and GEO for a small site or store, split into one-time launch steps, a recurring calendar and event runbooks: Google, Yandex, AI answers, content, semantic core, measurement, local profiles, query gaps. Ships standard-library Python tools (live-site check, site crawl, index coverage, Wordstat, SERP clustering, IndexNow) and GitHub Actions cron workflows. Every fact carries a source and a checked date.

keys_file.title: Keys file (optional)
keys_file.description: Path to your own keys file for the optional API steps (IndexNow, Yandex Webmaster, Search Console, Wordstat). Create it with: python scripts/seo_keys.py init ~/.config/seo-ops/keys.env, fill in the keys you have and keep it outside any repository. Only the path is stored here; the scripts read the keys from the file and never from the environment. Leave empty to use the pack without keys.
